{{Short description|Generalizes the Kodaira vanishing theorem for ample vector bundle}}
In [[algebraic geometry]], '''Le Potier's vanishing theorem''' is an extension of the [[Kodaira vanishing theorem]], on [[vector bundle]]s. The theorem states the following<ref name=Lazarsfeld2004>{{harv|Lazarsfeld|2004}}</ref><ref name=ShiffmanSommese1985>{{harv|Shiffman|Sommese|1985}}</ref><ref>{{harv|Demailly|1988}}</ref><ref>{{harv|Peternell|1994}}</ref><ref>{{harv|Laytimi|Nahm|2004}}</ref><ref>{{harv|Verdier|1974}}</ref><ref>{{harv|Schneider|1974}}</ref><ref>{{harv|Broer|1997}}</ref><ref>{{harv|Demailly|1996|loc=p.30}}</ref>
{{blockquote|{{harvtxt|Le Potier|1975}}:  Let X be a ''n''-dimensional compact [[complex manifold]] and E a [[holomorphic vector bundle]] of rank r over X, here <math>H^{p,q}(X,E)</math> is [[Dolbeault cohomology]] group, where <math>\Omega ^{p}_{X}</math> denotes the [[Sheaf (mathematics)|sheaf]] of [[Dolbeault complex|holomorphic ''p''-forms]] on ''X''. If E is an [[ample]], then
: <math> H^{p,q}(X, E) = 0</math> for <math>p + q \geq n + r</math> .

from [[Dolbeault theorem]],

: <math>H^{q}(X, \Omega ^{p}_{X} \otimes E ) = 0</math> for <math>p + q \geq n + r</math> .

By [[Serre duality]], the statements are equivalent to the assertions:

: <math>H^{i}(X, \Omega ^{j}_{X} \otimes E^* ) = 0</math> for <math>j + i \leq n - r</math> .}}

In case of r = 1, and let E is an ample (or positive) line bundle on X, this theorem is equivalent to the [[Nakano vanishing theorem]]. Also, {{harvtxt|Schneider|1974}} found another proof.

{{harvtxt|Sommese|1978}} generalizes Le Potier's vanishing theorem to k-ample and the statement as follows:{{R|ShiffmanSommese1985}}

{{blockquote| Le Potier–Sommese vanishing theorem: Let X be a ''n''-dimensional [[algebraic manifold]] and E is a k-ample holomorphic vector bundle of rank r over X, then
: <math> H^{p,q}(X, E) = 0</math> for <math>p + q \geq n + r + k</math> .}}

{{harvtxt|Demailly|1988}} gave a counterexample, which is as follows:{{R|Lazarsfeld2004}}<ref>{{harv|Manivel|1997}}</ref>

{{blockquote|Conjecture of {{harvtxt|Sommese|1978}}: Let X be a  ''n''-dimensional compact complex manifold and E a holomorphic vector bundle of rank r over X. If E is an ample, then
: <math>H^{p,q}(X, \Lambda^a E ) = 0</math> for <math>p + q \geq n + r - a + 1</math> is false for <math>n=2r \geq 6 .</math>

}}
